card.name: Words just before a verb phrase
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of a clause where a verb or noun phrase comes next, such as 'impaired' in 'patients with impaired renal function', a comma after 'or not', or 'they' before 'will'.

modes.label: Impaired before renal
modes.description: The word impaired (or Imp-aired) in 'with impaired renal function' in diuretic labels.
modes.example: Cumulative effects of the drug may develop in patients with<< impaired>>

modes.label: Subject or clause break in prose
modes.description: A comma or pronoun in older argumentative prose, right before the main verb.
modes.example: whether they are Catholics or not<<,>> affects their fortunes and their destiny

card.writes: It lowers the odds of 'shall' and 'shalt' as the next word, which fits a position where a plain verb is expected.
card.plain: It fires at points in a sentence where the next word is probably a verb, and it steers away from the word 'shall'.
